summary: Steep residential kerb among flats and houses; cars park here but homes are close.

best_section.where: Mid-street between two apartment blocks, south side

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 13 m (detached, at 104 m) and 20 m (Pent Court) either side; dense housing all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Ordinary sealed street with parked cars on the kerb; room to park in the lane edge.
drivers.convention: Other cars park along it, but 2P Mon-Fri 7am-6pm signs apply (resident permits excepted).

flags: Steep: about 11% over best section, 14% max
Low-lying at the east end (3.9 m) but no waterway mapped
sun_shade: Mixed; street trees shade part of the kerb, buildings shade from the north side.
